he: ד"א בראשית. בזכות התורה ברא הקב"ה את עולמו, שנקראת ראשית, שנאמר ה' קנני ראשית דרכו קדם מפעליו מאז (משלי ח כב):
en: Another thing in Bereshit. Thanks to the Torah, the Holy One created his world with his blessings, which is called the beginning, as it is said, God is the beginning of the beginning, and his works have preceded him ever since (Proverbs 8:22).
